```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library("ggplot2")
library("tidyverse")
library("lmerTest")
source("helpers.R")
```

```{r load-csv}
layers <- 1:12
spec_idx_path <- "../spec_idx"

layer_results <- lapply(layers, function(i) {
  path <- sprintf("%s/layer_%d_spec_idx.csv", spec_idx_path, i)
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  sort_hidden_act(i=i)
})

num_speaker <- length(unique(layer_results[[1]]$speaker))
```

```{r by-vowel plot}
lapply(seq_along(layer_results), function(i) {
  df <- layer_results[[i]]
  mean_vowel_results <- get_summary_vowels(df)
  by_vowel <- by_vowel_plot(results=df, mean_vowel_results=mean_vowel_results)
  plot_name <- sprintf("redo_spec_idx_by_vowels_plots/by_vowel_layer_%d.png", i)
  
  ggsave(filename = plot_name, plot = by_vowel, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
})
```

```{r by-speaker plot}
lapply(seq_along(layer_results), function(i) {
  df <- layer_results[[i]]
  mean_speaker_results <- get_summary_speakers(df)
  by_speaker <- by_speaker_plot(results=df, mean_speaker_results=mean_speaker_results)
  plot_name <- sprintf("redo_spec_idx_by_speakers_plots/by_speaker_layer_%d.png", i)
  
  ggsave(filename = plot_name, plot = by_speaker, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
})
```

```{r by-vowel-over-time}
merged_results <- bind_rows(layer_results)

all_vowels_trajectory <- merged_results %>%
  filter(!vowel %in% c("AW", "AY", "EY", "OW", "OY")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=layer, y=kld, color = vowel, group = vowel)) +
  xlab("Layers") +
  ylab("Kullback–Leibler divergence") +
  geom_point(alpha=0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype="dashed", size=2, color="red") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1) +   # line per vowel (mean across speakers)
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 12, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) + 
  facet_wrap(~vowel, ncol = 3) +     # 👈 this makes one subplot per vowel
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", 
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust=1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text (size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  


all_talkers_trajectory <- merged_results %>%
  filter(!vowel %in% c("AW", "AY", "EY", "OW", "OY")) %>% 
  mutate(speaker = factor(as.character(speaker))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=layer, y=kld, color = speaker, group = speaker)) +
  xlab("Layers") +
  ylab("Kullback–Leibler divergence") +
  geom_point(alpha=0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype="dashed", size=2, color="red") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1) +   # line per speaker (mean across vowels)
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 12, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", 
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust=1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text (size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
    
```

```{r lmer}
data <- read_csv("../figures/distribution_plots/kl_ratio_summary.csv")
m <- lm(r ~ vowel * layer + speaker, data=data)
summary(m)
```
```{r visualize-RSA}
marginals <- read_csv("../marginal_cors_across_layers.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-...1) %>% mutate(type="all-speakers")
specs <- read_csv("../spec_cors_across_layers.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-...1) %>% mutate(type="speaker-specific")

results <- rbind(marginals, specs)

type_order  <- c("all-speakers","speaker-specific")
results <- results |> 
  mutate(
    type  = factor(type,  levels = type_order),
    layer = factor(layer)
  )

p <- ggplot(results, aes(x = type, y = corr, color = type)) +
  geom_jitter(
    alpha = 0.2, size = 1.6,
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.6),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # mean ± 1 SEM pointrange (opaque)
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "pointrange",
    linewidth = 1,
    size = 0.4,
    position = position_nudge(x = 0.15),  # shift right; use -0.15 to shift left
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # colors & legend
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("all-speakers" = "#f1223e", "speaker-specific" = "#00b4d8"),
    guide = guide_legend(title = NULL)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ layer, ncol = 4, labeller = labeller(layer = function(x) paste0("Layer ", x))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Correlation") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black"),
    strip.text.x = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold")
  )

```

```{r run-stats-RSA}
# a linear model won't be right.
m <- lmer(corr ~ type * layer + (1|speaker), data=results)
summary(m)
```
